sources.why: P2S anecdote about overload at startup
sources.evidence: The 1000 overloads for about 5 seconds on initial bed heating on my p2s. Red light (overload), but no sound cause I have it muted.

sources.why: About power loss recovery, not UPS choice
sources.evidence: Just a quick heads-up: Power Loss Recovery is a standard feature across all Bambu Lab models.
Power was out a few weeks ago and the print finished and printer stayed on after that.
I notice that the X2D draws a lot more power while preheating the bed, so much so that it triggers the overload alarm on my Cyberpower 1350VA UPS.
Maximum power use will be while initially heating the bed, so do not start a print during an outage.
The H2D can hit 1300W max during the heat stage, and the P2S maxes out around 1000W.

sources.why: Runtime is for four printers, not one P1S
sources.evidence: Backup run time is about 20-30 minutes with all 4 printers running.
Bambu Lab says the P2S can draw a maximum of 1000W (@ 110v).

missing: A direct P1S recommendation: specific UPS or LiFePO4 power-station models with current prices, switchover time, and measured P1S power draw (bed-heating peak vs. steady printing), turned into runtime estimates for a 10-hour print and for short flickers.
why: Almost every result is a Bambu forum or Reddit thread with secondhand stories, mostly about other models (P2S, H2D, X2D, A1). The one non-forum page is a troubleshooting page that only says to use a UPS. No major reviewer or authority tests UPS units or power stations on a P1S, and nothing gives P1S runtimes. A focused page with measured draw, switchover times, current prices and a direct pick would stand out.
